title: Logs through Tram
description: Logs that the OTLP clients send to Tram and Tram forwards to OpenObserve. DEBUG logs are dropped by Tram's logs cel_filter stage, so only the checkout service shows up.

panels.title: Log records by service
panels.description: Records per histogram interval, which OpenObserve picks from the time range.

targets.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS zo_sql_key, service_name, count(*) AS records FROM "tram_logs" GROUP BY zo_sql_key, service_name ORDER BY zo_sql_key

panels.title: Log records by severity
panels.description: Only INFO arrives: the DEBUG logs of the debug-noise service never leave Tram.

targets.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS zo_sql_key, severity, count(*) AS records FROM "tram_logs" GROUP BY zo_sql_key, severity ORDER BY zo_sql_key

options.content: In dashboards the OpenObserve plugin only returns aggregations, not single log lines. To read the logs, open [Explore](/explore) with the OpenObserve datasource and the stream `tram_logs`, or the [OpenObserve UI](http://localhost:5080/web/logs?org_identifier=default&stream_type=logs&stream=tram_logs) (`root@example.com` / `Complexpass#123`).
